entities.summary: Vilhelm Georgiyevich Knorin (Russian: Вильге́льм Гео́ргиевич Кно́рин, Latvian: Vilhelms "Vilis" Knoriņš; was a Latvian Bolshevik revolutionary, Soviet politician, publicist and historian.
